fail_closed_rules: block terminal generation when reader_task is missing
block terminal generation when claim_boundary is missing
block terminal generation when source route is empty
block terminal generation when no transformation rule exists for the argument role
block terminal generation when text would expose raw ledger rows as prose

definition_model.claim_boundary: may introduce terms and scope; may not promote empirical or universal strength
definition_model.paragraph_purpose: define the local object, vocabulary, or reader task before claims are promoted
definition_model.required_source_use: use source bindings as explanatory support, not as a raw inventory

limits_falsifier.claim_boundary: must prevent unsupported TOE, all-domain, or superiority inflation
limits_falsifier.paragraph_purpose: state limits, falsifiers, negative controls, or reopening conditions
limits_falsifier.required_source_use: turn reviewer and failure-mode sources into explicit scientific boundaries

proof_evidence.claim_boundary: may promote only the exact bounded claim supported by the named route
proof_evidence.paragraph_purpose: bind the local claim to proof, evidence, replay, example, or source support
proof_evidence.required_source_use: name the support route in prose and keep exact paths in the source trace

synthesis_transition.claim_boundary: may connect results; may not add new unsupported claims
synthesis_transition.paragraph_purpose: synthesize the local route and hand the reader to the next obligation
synthesis_transition.required_source_use: summarize only established local support and state the next reading move

style_policy.source_trace_location: metadata/source trace fields, not dumped inside reader-facing paragraphs
style_policy.voice: clear scientific prose, continuous and reader-oriented
